task: Write a script that reads sales.csv (columns: region, amount — amount is a currency string like '19.99') and writes region_totals.csv with one row per region and its total amount. Include everything needed to run it end to end.

constraints.text: CSV processing stays on the standard library csv module; pandas and numpy came out of this service's dependency set in the 2026-03 slim-down
constraints.why: the pandas wheel pushed the Lambda bundle past the 250 MB cap and the deploy pipeline sat broken for a full day

constraints.text: currency amounts go through decimal.Decimal, not float arithmetic
constraints.why: float summation drifted region totals by three cents across 40k rows in the 2026-04 finance reconciliation and finance flagged the report

checks.description: no Decimal usage for currency math
